page.title: Civilian Economy
page.t: A public delivery hub serving the sector's civilian population. Construction is funded by the planetary economy. Once completed, it purchases goods to maintain civilian reserves.
Testing shortcut: invokes native instant build completion. May bypass construction materials and time. Reopen this menu for the next module.
Diagnostic snapshot updated every game minute and after recorded deliveries. Reopen the menu to refresh. Incoming goods count as supplies only after delivery.
Civilian Economy: this save contains the old energy-only prototype. Load a save from before installing Civilian Economy to test leveling. No migration or additional hub was created.

Civilian Economy: construction for population race %s could not be prepared. Check the component definitions and debug log. No replacement components were selected.
Debug shortcut: bypass growth requirements and automatically finish the required construction. Layout generation may take time.
Sales tax received: %s\n%s: %s units of %s sold to the civilian hub.
%s: civilian hub upgrading to level %s. Construction phase started.
%s: civilian hub construction complete. Level %s is now accepting newly unlocked goods.
%s: civilian hub construction complete. Level %s is now accepting increased quantities of existing goods.
%s: civilian hub construction complete at level %s. New purchase offers are currently paused.
Civilian debug hub creation failed: select a valid sector.
Civilian debug hub creation cancelled: this sector already has a hub.
Civilian debug hub creation failed: neither the sector profile nor the Argon fallback has valid demand and construction components.
Civilian debug hub creation could not create a station. The fixed population is saved; normal reconciliation will retry. Check the debug log.

Create an ownerless civilian hub with a fixed population of 5 billion. Automatically finish its initial construction after a valid layout is ready. Use an Argon profile if this sector has no valid civilian profile. Placement may take time.
Show civilian hub testing actions in the right-click menu. Disabled by default. Settings are stored in this save.

Scale civilian consumption and purchase targets. 0.1 means 10% of normal demand; 1.0 is normal; 10.0 means ten times normal demand. Existing reserves and trades are preserved. Construction materials are unaffected.

Scale the supplied time required to reach the next level. 0.1 requires one tenth of normal time; 1.0 is normal; 10.0 requires ten times normal time. Earned growth is preserved. Construction time is unaffected.
Show ticker and logbook messages for civilian sales-tax income. Tax is still paid when messages are disabled. Enabled by default.
Percentage of completed civilian purchases paid as extra tax income in player-owned sectors. 0 disables tax income; default is 15%. Seller payments are unaffected.
%1: unrest reduces civilian tax income by %2%%. Effective tax rate: %3%%.
%1: civilian tax income restored. Effective tax rate: %2%%.
Pirate mobilisation detected in %1, departing from %2. %3 tier: %4 ships - %5.
Storage sabotage at %1 in %2: %4 units of %3 ejected.
Critical unrest in %1. Restore essential supplies within 60 game-minutes to prevent destructive sabotage and capital raids.
Performs the real action and its normal notifications. Incident tests bypass unrest and cooldowns, but retain target checks and raid limits. Module destruction can destroy the station's last module.
No eligible local player station or component; targets may already be affected or have insufficient cargo.
This hub already has five active raid groups. Withdrawing groups count toward this limit.
The hub does not have enough free, operational docks and piers compatible with this raid. Wait for docked ships to depart and try again.
The engine did not confirm the requested effect. See the debug log.
Incident cooldowns reset for this hub and local player stations. Active effects remain.
The raid could not depart within ten game-minutes. Its ships are withdrawing; piracy did not begin.
The capital raider could not be provisioned with five cargo drones.
%1 M raiders, %2 S escorts, %3 L destroyers
two M raiders and two S escorts
one L destroyer, two M raiders and four S escorts
Independent raiders emerging from prolonged civilian shortages.
Set civilian reserves to a random amount between the current balance and capacity.
Add one hour of supplied time, capped at the current level's growth requirement.
%1: %2. Demand for %3 increases by %4%% for 2 game hours.
%1: %2. Demand for %3 decreases by %4%% for 2 game hours.
%1: %2 has ended. Demand for %3 has returned to normal.
Start this event for 2 game hours alongside compatible events. Uses a random strength and only currently consumed goods.
End the selected events and restore demand for their goods. Other events remain active. No cooldown is applied.
Requires an operational civilian hub, applicable unlocked goods and a current status snapshot. An active event must not affect any of the same goods.
Native construction has not started. A valid layout is needed before construction can be completed.
Destroys all CE hubs and clears CE progress, events, unrest, debug populations and active raids. Settings and player finances stay unchanged. Reopen this menu within 30 seconds to confirm.
Confirm reset of all CE hubs
Reset is waiting for visitors or the player to leave, object removal, or population data. No duplicate hubs will be created.
CE reset complete. New level-1 hubs appear fully built once planning finishes.
Play news videos for civilian incidents. When disabled, ticker messages and logbook entries are still shown.
